summary: Chemung Financial Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K on October 1, 2026, reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary, Chemung Canal Trust Company, completed conversion from a New York-chartered trust company to a national bank on the same date after Office of the Comptroller of the Currency approval. The institution now operates as Chemung Canal Trust Company, National Association, supervised, regulated, and examined by the OCC, while continuing as the same corporate entity within the same structure. No change in ownership, capital, securities, or strategic direction is involved; this is a purely regulatory charter conversion, not a special situation, with no deal terms to watch.
